description: Read a sitemap.xml (or a site's default sitemap): URLs with lastmod, child sitemaps. Fetches a sitemap URL, or for a bare site URL tries the sitemaps declared in robots.txt and then /sitemap.xml. Returns page URLs with lastmod/changefreq/priority, or the child sitemaps of a sitemap index. Up to 5,000 entries; gzip sitemaps are not decoded. Price: $0.008 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
